description: Convert an amount between any two currencies at the latest or a historical rate. Returns the converted amount, the rate used, the actual rate date, and whether the date was snapped from a weekend/holiday to the prior business day. Cross-rates are triangulated through EUR automatically.

amount.description: Amount in the base currency to convert. Must be greater than zero.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 source currency code (e.g. USD). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a historical rate. Omit for the latest available rate. ECB data starts 1999-01-04. Future dates are not supported.

quote_currency.description: ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. EUR). The amount will be expressed in this currency. Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

name: fx_convert_currency

base_amount.description: The input amount in the base currency.

date_snapped.description: True when the API returned a different date than requested — ECB silently snaps weekend/holiday requests to the prior business day.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_format`: date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD. `unsupported_currency`: base_currency or quote_currency is not in the ECB currency set. `date_out_of_range`: date is before 1999-01-04 or in the future. `upstream_no_data`: Both currencies are supported but the ECB published no rate for this date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

quote_amount.description: The converted amount in the quote currency, rounded to 6 decimal places.

rate.description: Exchange rate used: units of quote currency per 1 unit of base currency.

rate_date.description: Actual date of the rate used for conversion.

rate_type.description: Always "ECB reference (mid-market)" — these are reference rates, not tradeable bid/ask.

source.description: Always "ECB via Frankfurter" — the upstream data provider.

title: Fx Convert Currency
